description: MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator) personality knowledge for GENESIS RAG

INTJ.name: The Architect
INTJ.communication: Direct, logical, and efficient. Values competence and intellectual depth.
INTJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may become hypersensitive to sensory details or overindulge in physical pleasures (inferior Se).
INTJ.growthPath: Learn to appreciate present moments, connect with emotions, and be more patient with others' processes.

lunaGuidance.approach: Engage intellectually. INTJs appreciate depth, competence, and efficiency in conversation.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They may seem cold but have deep inner values. Don't mistake brevity for disinterest.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Small talk, emotional appeals without logic, inefficiency, or challenging their competence.
keyPhrases: I see the logic in that

INTP.name: The Logician
INTP.communication: Prefers exploring ideas and theories. May seem detached but is deeply curious.
INTP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become uncharacteristically emotional or seek external validation (inferior Fe).
INTP.growthPath: Develop emotional awareness, follow through on projects, and connect with others authentically.

lunaGuidance.approach: Explore ideas together. INTPs love intellectual exploration without pressure for conclusions.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They process internally and may need time to formulate responses. Silence means thinking.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Demanding immediate emotional responses, rigid structures, or dismissing their theories.

ENTJ.name: The Commander
ENTJ.communication: Direct and assertive. Values efficiency and results in conversation.
ENTJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may become hypersensitive to criticism or feel unappreciated (inferior Fi).
ENTJ.growthPath: Develop patience, emotional intelligence, and appreciation for others' contributions.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be direct and confident. ENTJs respect those who can hold their ground intellectually.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: Behind the commanding exterior is someone who deeply cares about making an impact.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being wishy-washy, overly emotional without logic, or wasting their time.

ENTP.name: The Debater
ENTP.communication: Loves debate and intellectual sparring. Enjoys playing devil's advocate.
ENTP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become obsessed with details or past mistakes (inferior Si).
ENTP.growthPath: Develop follow-through, sensitivity to others' feelings, and attention to practical details.

lunaGuidance.approach: Engage playfully in ideas. ENTPs love intellectual banter and exploring possibilities.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: Their challenging nature is about exploring truth, not attacking you personally.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Taking debates personally, being overly sensitive, or demanding conformity.
keyPhrases: What if we looked at it this way...

INFJ.name: The Advocate
INFJ.communication: Thoughtful and meaningful. Prefers deep conversations over small talk.
INFJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may become impulsive or overindulge in sensory pleasures (inferior Se).
INFJ.growthPath: Set boundaries, accept imperfection, and balance idealism with practicality.

lunaGuidance.approach: Create a safe, meaningful space. INFJs open up slowly but deeply with trust.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They often feel misunderstood. Being truly seen and heard is profoundly meaningful.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Surface-level conversation, invading their privacy, or dismissing their intuitions.
keyPhrases: I sense there's more beneath that
What does your intuition tell you?

INFP.name: The Mediator
INFP.communication: Values authenticity and emotional depth. May take time to share inner world.
INFP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become harshly critical or obsessed with organizing (inferior Te).
INFP.growthPath: Develop practical skills, share feelings more openly, and accept imperfect reality.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be authentic and non-judgmental. INFPs need to feel emotionally safe to open up.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They feel things deeply. What seems like overreaction is genuine emotional experience.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being fake, dismissing their feelings, or pressuring them to be practical.
keyPhrases: What matters most to you about this?

ENFJ.name: The Protagonist
ENFJ.communication: Warm, encouraging, and attentive. Focused on understanding and helping others.
ENFJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may become overly critical or analytical (inferior Ti).
ENFJ.growthPath: Set boundaries, accept that you can't help everyone, and attend to your own needs.

lunaGuidance.approach: Appreciate their giving nature while gently encouraging self-care.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They often neglect their own needs while caring for others. Help them feel cared for.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Taking without giving, being ungrateful, or dismissing their concerns for others.
keyPhrases: How are YOU feeling about this?
Your insight into people is remarkable

ENFP.name: The Campaigner
ENFP.communication: Enthusiastic and idea-driven. Loves exploring possibilities and connecting deeply.
ENFP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become obsessive about details or past mistakes (inferior Si).
ENFP.growthPath: Develop focus, follow through on commitments, and find validation from within.

lunaGuidance.approach: Match their energy and enthusiasm. ENFPs thrive on positive, exploratory conversations.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: Behind the bubbly exterior can be deep feelings. They may need help processing emotions.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Shutting down their ideas, being overly negative, or demanding strict routine.
keyPhrases: That's a creative way to look at it

ISTJ.name: The Logistician
ISTJ.communication: Direct and factual. Values clear information and proven methods.
ISTJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may catastrophize or imagine worst-case scenarios (inferior Ne).
ISTJ.growthPath: Embrace change, consider others' feelings, and explore new possibilities.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be reliable and factual. ISTJs appreciate consistency and proven approaches.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They show care through actions, not words. Their reliability IS their love language.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being flaky, overly abstract, or dismissing tradition without good reason.

ISFJ.name: The Defender
ISFJ.communication: Warm and attentive. Remembers details about others and shows care through service.
ISFJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may worry about worst-case scenarios or become pessimistic (inferior Ne).
ISFJ.growthPath: Assert your own needs, embrace change, and accept recognition for contributions.

lunaGuidance.approach: Show appreciation for their care. ISFJs often give more than they receive.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They may suppress their own needs. Help them feel safe expressing what they want.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Taking them for granted, being unreliable, or dismissing their concerns.
keyPhrases: I noticed you did that for me

ESTJ.name: The Executive
ESTJ.communication: Direct and to-the-point. Values efficiency and clear expectations.
ESTJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may become hypersensitive or feel unappreciated (inferior Fi).
ESTJ.growthPath: Develop emotional intelligence, flexibility, and appreciation for different approaches.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be organized and straightforward. ESTJs appreciate efficiency and clear communication.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: Their need for order comes from wanting security. Structure helps them feel safe.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being disorganized, wishy-washy, or challenging rules without good reason.

ESFJ.name: The Consul
ESFJ.communication: Warm, attentive, and focused on harmony. Remembers personal details.
ESFJ.stressResponse: Under stress, may become overly critical or nitpicky (inferior Ti).
ESFJ.growthPath: Develop independence, accept that not everyone will approve, and embrace change.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be warm and appreciative. ESFJs thrive on positive feedback and connection.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They need to feel valued and included. Exclusion or criticism cuts deep.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being cold, ungrateful, or dismissing their efforts to help.
keyPhrases: Thank you for thinking of me

ISTP.name: The Virtuoso
ISTP.communication: Practical and concise. Prefers actions over words.
ISTP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become emotional or seek validation (inferior Fe).
ISTP.growthPath: Develop emotional expression, commitment to long-term goals, and connection with others.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be practical and give them space. ISTPs need autonomy and hands-on engagement.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They show love through actions and fixing things. Words may feel inadequate to them.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being clingy, overly emotional, or demanding verbal affirmation.

ISFP.name: The Adventurer
ISFP.communication: Gentle and authentic. Expresses through art and experience more than words.
ISFP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become harshly critical or controlling (inferior Te).
ISFP.growthPath: Develop assertiveness, long-term planning, and comfort with conflict when necessary.

lunaGuidance.approach: Appreciate their artistic nature. ISFPs need non-judgmental acceptance.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They feel deeply but may not express it verbally. Watch for non-verbal cues.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being harsh, demanding explanations, or dismissing their creative expressions.
keyPhrases: I love how you see the world
What does this feel like to you?

ESTP.name: The Entrepreneur
ESTP.communication: Direct, energetic, and focused on the present. Loves banter and action.
ESTP.stressResponse: Under stress, may become paranoid or see hidden meanings (inferior Ni).
ESTP.growthPath: Develop patience, consider long-term consequences, and sensitivity to others.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be direct and engage in the present moment. ESTPs love action and adventure.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: They may avoid emotional depth but care deeply when it matters.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being slow, overly theoretical, or dwelling on feelings without action.

ESFP.name: The Entertainer
ESFP.communication: Fun, energetic, and people-oriented. Brings joy and spontaneity to interactions.
ESFP.stressResponse: Under stress, may worry about the future or see negative patterns (inferior Ni).
ESFP.growthPath: Develop focus, long-term planning, and comfort with deeper emotional conversations.

lunaGuidance.approach: Be fun and present. ESFPs thrive on positive energy and shared experiences.
lunaGuidance.keyInsight: Behind the fun exterior, they feel deeply. Don't assume everything is surface-level.
lunaGuidance.avoid: Being a downer, overly serious, or criticizing their spontaneity.

Ni.name: Introverted Intuition
Ni.description: Synthesizes information into future visions and deep insights

Ne.name: Extraverted Intuition
Ne.description: Explores possibilities, patterns, and connections in the external world

Si.name: Introverted Sensing
Si.description: Stores and recalls detailed past experiences and established methods

Se.name: Extraverted Sensing
Se.description: Engages with the present moment through immediate sensory experience

Ti.name: Introverted Thinking
Ti.description: Analyzes and organizes information into logical frameworks

Te.name: Extraverted Thinking
Te.description: Organizes the external world efficiently and systematically

Fi.name: Introverted Feeling
Fi.description: Evaluates based on internal values and authentic emotional experience

Fe.name: Extraverted Feeling
Fe.description: Harmonizes with and responds to others' emotional states

NT.name: Rationals
NT.description: Strategic, logical, and driven by competence and knowledge

NF.name: Idealists
NF.description: Empathetic, authentic, and driven by meaning and personal growth

SJ.name: Guardians
SJ.description: Reliable, traditional, and driven by duty and security

SP.name: Artisans
SP.description: Practical, adaptable, and driven by action and experience
